title: Daylight saving time 2026 ending: When to 'fall back' - ABC11 News
text:
Daylight savings to end in RI, for now. All 2026 to 2036 dates PGA Tour LPGA College Amateur Golf Life Real Estate Equipment Apparel Newsletters LOCAL Daylight saving time ends soon in RI. List of fall back dates till 2036
 When is daylight savings? Change clocks or 'fall back' at 2 am ET Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026. Then we 'spring forward' an hour ahead Sunday, March 14, 2027.
 Jennifer Sangalang Hazel Gandhi USA TODAY NETWORK - New England Oct. 23, 2026, 9:21 a.m. ET With daylight savings ending soon, it may be surprising to know "fall back" and "spring forward" dates are set till 2036.
 What is daylight savings? It's when clocks are moved 1 hour ahead, or spring forward, and 1 hour back, or fall back.
 What is the Sunshine Protection Act? It would permanently extend daylight savings from 8 months of the year to the full 12 months.
 Daylight saving time is coming to an end in a little over a week, and while it is always confusing when exactly to switch your clocks, the dates for "fall back" and "spring forward" have actually been set for the next 10 years.
 Each year, clocks are set back by one hour on the Sunday after Halloween and forward by one hour on the second Sunday in March to save more daylight hours. In early November, we'll gain an hour when the clocks are set back.
 Below is information about daylight saving time, commonly referred to as " daylight savings ," why we change clocks twice a year and a list of dates to fall back and spring forward from 2026 to 2036.
 When does daylight saving time end in 2026?
 Daylight saving time "ends" at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026 (Halloween weekend!), for "fall back."

 Daylight saving time is the period of the year when clocks are moved one hour ahead, or "spring forward," according to the National Institute of Standards and Technology , to create "more sunlit hours in the evening during months when the weather is the warmest." We move clocks back one hour or "fall back" when we return to standard time. "The transition from ST to DST (standard time to daylight saving time) has the effect of moving one hour of daylight from the morning to the evening. The transition from DST to ST effectively moves one hour of daylight from the evening to the morning," the NIST site explains .
 Daylight saving time, commonly (and incorrectly) referred to as "daylight savings," was formally introduced in the U.S. in 1918.
 Who's in charge of daylight saving time?
 The U.S. Department of Transportation regulates daylight saving time and time zones. However, the National Institute of Standards and Technology, or NIST, acts as an official timekeeper for the U.S.
 When is daylight savings in 2027?
 Daylight saving time starts (again) at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 14, 2027, for "spring forward."
 Daylight saving time then "ends" at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 7, 2027, for "fall back."
 Why can't we end daylight saving time permanently? Did Sunshine Protection Act pass?
 The  Sunshine Protection Act  would permanently extend daylight saving time from eight months of the year to the full 12 months. The bill was first introduced in March 2018 by then- Sen. Marco Rubio, R-Florida , now Secretary of State in the second Trump administration, and Rep. Vern Buchanan. The pair reintroduced the bill, along with other sponsors, in 2019, 2021 and 2023. However, the bills were never passed by the U.S. House of Representatives, and they have never been signed into law.
 In January 2025, U.S. Sen. Rick Scott introduced the Sunshine Protection Act of 2025 to officially “ lock the clock” , end the twice-yearly time change and make daylight saving time the national yearround standard across the U.S.
 The measures introduced in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023 and 2025 were not passed by the U.S. House of Representatives, nor were they signed into law by Trump during his first administration and by former President Biden.

 In July 2026, the House of Representatives voted "yes" on the Sunshine Protection Act, which would leave it up to each state to decide whether to make daylight saving time permanent. However, no vote was scheduled on it, and lawmakers left the Capitol for a recess/break and will not return until after the time change, on Nov. 9, 2026.
 Daylight savings dates from 2026 to 2036
 These dates list the end and start of daylight saving time through at least the year 2036, according to sites like timeanddate.com , time.is and calendar-12.com .
 Daylight saving time 2026: DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026, the day after the Halloween holiday, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2027: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 14, 2027, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 7, 2027, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2028: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 12, 2028, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 5, 2028, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2029: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 11, 2029, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 4, 2029, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2030: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 10, 2030, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 3, 2030, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2031: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 9, 2031, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 2, 2031, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2032: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 14, 2032, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 7, 2032, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2033: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 13, 2033, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 6, 2033, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2034: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 12, 2034, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 5, 2034, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2035: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 11, 2035, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 4, 2035, for fall back.
 Daylight saving time 2036: DST starts at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, March 9, 2027, for spring forward. DST ends at 2 a.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 2, 2027, for fall back.
